links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM chatbot diagnosis and triage/follow-up recommendations for simulated retina emergency calls versus humans
links.effect: Humans more accurate than chatbots in diagnosis (95% vs 76.7%, P<.01) and follow-up (85% vs 70%, P=.03); ChatGPT and Claude noninferior, Gemini (50%) and Meta (46.7%) worse in follow-up.
links.quote: Human graders were significantly more accurate than chatbots in diagnosis (95% vs 76.7%, respectively; P < .01) and follow-up recommendations (85% vs 70%, respectively; P = .03).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the diagnostic and triage accuracy of LLMs compared to human staff using simulated telephone triage cases, but does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
